_comment: Trimmed, real-shape sample of GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, captured 2026-09-26. Fields kept: id, canonical_slug, name, context_length, pricing — enough to exercise checkChain's data[].id lookup without carrying the full ~460-model, ~750KB real response. Values are copied verbatim from the live API; only the entry list was trimmed. z-ai/glm-5.3-prime is real and, as of capture, has NO entry in zdr-sample.json's real ZDR data — kept deliberately so upstreamCore.test.mjs can exercise the 'in the catalog but no ZDR coverage' problem against real data instead of a fabricated model id.
